recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Do not re-add participant-role binding text to CarePlan unless the Patient Care work group reverses the CarePlan.careTeam modeling decision.
issue_request: FHIR-3123 is Published/Persuasive and asked for a value set for CarePlan.participant.role because the role element was unconstrained.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites SVN #6813. Imported git commit 45a51719e6c526a6bf7df614e1b9f7d5f8c3b4bf changed CarePlanParticipantRole from unbound to an example value-set binding and added valueset-participant-role.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-9765 later replaced CarePlan.participant with CarePlan.careTeam referencing CareTeam. FHIR-6212 is the same binding-change family and explicitly referred to FHIR-3123 in its resolution.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The old CarePlan.participant.role element is no longer active, and CareTeam.participant.role is example-bound to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/participant-role.
